answer: Ephemeral challenge seeding. Each identity is admitted only by answering a fresh task whose seed derives from an onyx-hard randomness beacon published at dawn; the task demands a sparrow-level unique artifact computed against the agent's private key, and the beacon seed is discarded after one epoch. Anyone replaying a prior answer fails because the seed no longer exists. The cost to an attacker is per-identity live compute tied to a one-time beacon window, so mass cloning means paying full computation for every clone at each dawn and never amortizing it across identities or epochs.
